Title: Azure Stream Analytics tools for Visual Studio April 2019 Update

Body.Content:
Here is the list of April updates to the Stream Analytics tools for Visual Studio.
 

Local testing: Support for running highlighted steps locally.

Support Stream Analytics new features

  • Blob output partitioning by custom datetime
  • High throughput output to SQL
  • Compatibility level 1.2
  • Fully partitioned queries
  • Geospatial for Edge jobs
Add intellisense support for
  • Anomaly detection functions.
  • User defined custom re-partition count.
  • New SQL functions.
